page.content:
Wales's web company that funded Nupedia and early Wikipedia.

How Bomis connects

  • Work: Nupedia — Bomis paid for Nupedia's early staff and hosting.
  • Topic: Wikipedia — Bomis also hosted Wikipedia until the Wikimedia Foundation formed.

What is Bomis?

Bomis was the for-profit portal that paid for Nupedia's staff and servers until the nonprofit Wikimedia Foundation took over the encyclopedia.

Key threads lead to Nupedia and Wikipedia.
